# A producer's actual published result becomes its consumer's input through
# the artifact lifecycle, and the workflow survives a restart of the same
# daemon. Only Linux qualifies the local workspace snapshot this needs.
[!GOOS:linux] skip 'UNRUN: actual result-to-input handoff requires the Linux local workspace snapshot; this script remains required'
private-workdir
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
server start
skygo --token-file alice.token info --target local --require workdir-snapshot-v1
skygo --token-file alice.token artifacts upload source
cp stdout seed.json
graph-file handoff.tmpl handoff.yaml seed.json
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f handoff.yaml --request-id handoff
json-field id WF
await-workflow alice.token $WF consume succeeded
cp stdout done.json
json-field nodes.0.job_id PRODUCER
json-field nodes.1.job_id CONSUMER
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs get $PRODUCER
cp stdout producer.json
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs get $CONSUMER
cp stdout consumer.json
same-input done.json consume producer.json consumer.json
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $CONSUMER
cmp stdout expected.txt
event-count 2
calls ControlService/BeginArtifactUpload 1
calls job-submissions 0

# Replay after a restart neither reads the local input again nor runs any
# node again.
rm source/seed.txt
server stop
! stderr .
server start
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f handoff.yaml --request-id handoff
cmp stdout done.json
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $CONSUMER
cmp stdout expected.txt
event-count 2
calls ControlService/BeginArtifactUpload 1
calls job-submissions 0
server stop
! stderr .

-- source/seed.txt --
seed
-- expected.txt --
seed
prepared
-- handoff.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: produce
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: produce, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: produce}
    workdir: {id: "@REF_ID@", sha256: "@REF_SHA256@", size: @REF_SIZE@}
    setup: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$", "--", "setup"]
    outputs: [out]
- name: consume
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: consume, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: consume}
  depends_on: [produce]
  input: {node: produce, slot: result}
